# Charter — DESIGN-PUBLISH: Publish the SPEC_V2 studio design pack, live

Programme: conveyor buildout · Tranche 0 · Track: programme · Plan: `docs/design/STUDIO-SPEC.md`
Recorded retrospectively on 2026-11-21, for a project that closed without a charter record.

## Mandate

Publish the studio design pack so the SPEC_V2 operating model is readable, challengeable and reusable from a browser, and keep it live from the application image rather than a hand-copied mirror. The pack keeps three things distinct on every screen: V1 surfaces implemented in the Rust app, V2 destinations that carry a `V2 · PROPOSED` ribbon with no write path, and legacy study surfaces that stay reachable and banner-labelled. It claims no V2 code.

## Scope

In: `docs/design/` — `STUDIO-SPEC.md`, `README.md`, `studio.html` (the offline entry), `v2.js` / `v2.css` (the V2 study surfaces), `architecture/` (ArchiMate and pre-rendered Mermaid), `assets/`, `data/` (the generated snapshot) and `docs/` (Markdown rendered to standalone HTML) — with the scripts that check them; served at `https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/` from the app image, beside the operator console behind the sign-in gate.

Out: the V2 backend (none has been written); a signed-out write path (`console.js` makes no API request without a session); the homepage mirror `nonagentic.ai/design`, retired 2026-11-18 and 308-redirecting to the app-served pack; the S17–S21 instruments and the V1 screens, which the pack references rather than re-implements.

## Expected and closure outputs

- Expected, due now: `project-brief` and `evidence` — both published, both listed for this project in `docs/design/docs/outputs.js`.
- At closure: `closure-review` — published by the 2026-11-21 retrospective rework.

The class is `programme` in `seed/output-standard.json` version 2; `scripts/build-programme-seed.py` writes the due-now and at-closure sets into the project's `meta`.

## Benefit link

**B1 — Auditable decisions** (target: every choice has a decision row; status `draft`; baseline "not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)"). The pack carries the publication half of B1: a row is public only through an admin's `documents.publish`, every output carries its author, its version and a revision history, and the data snapshot is bound by a sha256 manifest.

The live benefit-link table records this project's operational outcome as **O6 "The public can see and challenge the design"** (B4 Public collaboration, target: every output is reachable). That row is recorded here beside B1, not replaced by it.

## Tranche 0

Tranche 0 (`01a1e9e0-ced2-7769-b12f-f6fba0997914`) — entry: "the programme is mandated and P0 exists"; exit: "every project in tranche 0 (DESIGN-PUBLISH, P0, PLATFORM, S00, S01, SPEC-V2, T0) meets its acceptance with published evidence, and the review records continue, pause or stop". The tranche is closed. Its review records `continue`, authorised by the programme owner on 2026-11-17 (the review row is dated 2026-11-18), with the six benefit profiles unmeasured and the BCM unstaffed named as open risk.

## Acceptance

The project's acceptance is its manifest, `acceptance/programme/DESIGN-PUBLISH.toml`, and its gate reads in full:

> The closure review exists and every declared closure output is published; the project re-closes through the one gate.

Its P0 checks: the project is closed; the scope baseline is approved and the close gate reads the approved row; the charter asset exists and its gate is approved; the declared closure outputs are declared and published; a live board-approved delivery contract exists; the Phase-G review cites a published standing delegation; the closure gate was decided by an approver other than its requester; no active waiver is expired or owned by its reviewer; the PI has a cadence row and a backlog-refinement row; every WBS deliverable carries the four typed WSJF inputs; every accepted deliverable has a demo credit carrying its evidence.

The project's own gate is `acceptance/programme/DESIGN-PUBLISH.toml`.

# Closure review — DESIGN-PUBLISH (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

Project: DESIGN-PUBLISH — Publish the SPEC_V2 studio design pack, live · Track: programme · Tranche: 0 · Plan: docs/design/STUDIO-SPEC.md
Recorded retrospectively on 2026-11-21 under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`. The runtime timestamp of the first close is not carried in the snapshot — not recoverable; the project row's `updated_at` is 2026-11-21T01:04:58Z.

## Outcome vs acceptance

The acceptance set is the project brief's four criteria plus the project's manifest gate. Evidence is measured against the tree at main@7314a2d0 and the live pack on 2026-11-21.

| Criterion | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| The public site renders the programme from Postgres | `data/snapshot.js` is written from the tenant's rows; the public sidebar names the programme only when the snapshot carries it (#470, 7d4e0d27); `/design/data/programme.json` returned 48 projects and this project's closed row at 17:36Z | pass |
| A published output appears at its stable URL | 165 committed output pages, every one named by `docs/design/docs/outputs.js` (check-outputs.cjs, #516); `/design/docs/output-01a1e686-6efd-7683-9d5a-27e5b05081de.html` returned 200 live | pass |
| Signed out there is no API request and no write control | `node docs/design/scripts/check-console.cjs` proves a signed-out pack makes zero API requests, a signed-in one sends the actions it renders, and the 401/412 paths are rendered; it is a step of the design-pack job | pass |
| The pack's claims are checked like code | the design-pack job runs `build-coverage.py --check`, `build-docs.py --check`, the conformance audit and the output-standard check, with the six surface checks | pass |
| The manifest gate: the closure review exists and every declared closure output is published; the project re-closes through the one gate | this document, published by `documents.compose` and `documents.publish`; the project declares `closure-review`; the closure decided by `conveyor-approver` | pass — this record |

One measured deviation, carried to Open items rather than counted as a pass: the live public window at 2026-11-21T17:36Z names 102 outputs (index generated 17:23:48Z) and not this project's `project-brief`, so `https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/docs/output-01a1e007-1347-7298-8987-ea4c3b739d02.html` returns 404 while the committed pack carries the page and names it. The criterion above is satisfied by the evidence output's stable URL; the brief's absence is a state of the publication window.

## Evidence

- **Units.** #32 (publish the pack at conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design), #33 (live build surface), #36 (the public build surface — sanitation, docs-as-HTML, feedback links), #37 (wipe history, flip the repo public, republish), #89 (the V2 registration true in the index and the seed), #97 (the A5 live engine proof), #103 (measure the plan, derive the tranches, publish the truth), #149 (the work store — expected outputs and the checklist): all closed.
- **Commits.** 96a3d47b 2026-11-12 (the pack's first commit); 5cf3d758 2026-11-13 (the authenticated operator surface); 085b11d0 2026-11-15 (the live public window from Postgres); 318fa4d1 2026-11-16 (one output standard and the next-output queue); eebf7c14 2026-11-16 (#149, expected outputs and the project checklist); 0ae39771 2026-11-19 (#97, the A5 live engine proof); 9da8e8c1 2026-11-20 (publish the programme snapshot); 06ba0fe3 2026-11-20 (restore the 165 output pages and refuse the index/pages drift, #515/#516).

- **Live, 2026-11-21T17:36Z.** `/design/` 200; `/design/data/manifest.json` 200 with git_sha a33e6562; `/design/data/programme.json` 200, generated 17:23:48Z; `/design/docs/output-01a1e686-6efd-7683-9d5a-27e5b05081de.html` 200; `/design/docs/output-01a1e007-1347-7298-8987-ea4c3b739d02.html` 404.

## Open items

Each gap is carried here with an owner and a next step; none is treated as satisfied.

- **The live window is narrower than the committed pack** — 102 live outputs against 165 committed pages at 2026-11-21T17:36Z, and this project's `project-brief` (01a1e007-1347-7298-8987-ea4c3b739d02) 404s live. Owner: the tenant admin publisher with the design-pack unit. Next step: establish whether the brief was unpublished or the window was regenerated from a narrower row set, then republish or record the unpublish as a decision.
- **The committed data lags the tree** — the committed snapshot is generated at a33e6562 while origin/main is 7314a2d0 (2026-11-21); the issue-registry workflow regenerates it on a generated-data PR. Owner: design-pack unit. Next step: confirm the next generated PR carries the current registry.

- **The first close's timestamp is not in the snapshot** — the project row carries `updated_at` 2026-11-21T01:04:58Z and no closed-at field; the closure date is not recoverable from the pack.

## Decision

Close. The delivery is compliant: the four acceptance criteria and the manifest gate hold on the evidence above, and the two findings that kept the earlier close open — P0 `closed_without_closure_review` and P1 `unpublished_declared_output` — are cleared by this published record. The closure decision is taken by `conveyor-approver`, distinct from the requester `conveyor-e2e`, under delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`. The open items above are owned and dated; they are not conditions of the close.

# Project brief — DESIGN-PUBLISH (retrospective, 2026-11-26)

## Outcome

DESIGN-PUBLISH publishes the SPEC_V2 studio design pack live. The project delivers the Project Brief, Evidence and Closure review outputs and the seven Phase A–D artefact documents dated 2026-11-22. The committed pack carries 165 outputs; the live public window carries 102 at the 2026-11-21 record. This brief is retrospective and dated 2026-11-26: it records the outcome the rework note describes, not a newly claimed delivery.

## Boundary

Out of scope is the republish from live rows, which the rework note assigns to U7, and any change to the live public window by this project. The project also does not re-author the seven A–D artefact documents, which were published on 2026-11-22; it adds the Phase E–H artefact content and the governance records the retro pack requires, including this brief.

## Reuse sources

The record reuses the snapshot's own rows: artefacts.json documents for the ten project documents, msp.json for the WBS deliverable 01a1ff3e-50d7-74e4-bf2c-5e866b75cc86 and the benefit profile 01a1e9df-1592-79a5-839e-037d8fe4251b, and programme.json for the project's meta. The rework note docs/evidence/rework/DESIGN-PUBLISH.md supplies the residuals, and docs/evidence/rework/DESIGN-PUBLISH.json supplies the acceptance state.

## Inception units

The project carries GitHub issues 32, 33, 36, 37, 89, 97, 103 and 149 in its meta, and it sits in tranche 0 under PI cadence 01a1ff21-33f0-7e5a-bafc-b09b6fc73c13 and refinement 01a1ff21-547f-73e8-b256-4bee7fdc9c70. The retrospective reconstitution of the lifecycle is the #526 unit; its 37 acts are the record of the work, read back one write at a time.

## Dependencies

The public window depends on U7's republish from live rows, and the project depends on the standing delegation 01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14 for its approvals. The benefit depends on the published pack, and the artefact packages depend on this content pack being applied by the rework batch before their red state can clear.

The later 2026-11-25 acceptance record is red on the artefact standard, which this pack addresses.
